title: Cadence restart fires on every post-correction batch — all labeled invitation_sent
detail: After the first post-correction batch, `cycle_index + 1` leaves `batch_index` at 1, so every later post-correction batch (co-nudge, reminders) re-matches `Gt if batch_index > 0` and restarts at 0 — all labeled `invitation_sent`, ordinals never emitted.
recommended_fix: Track a `restarted` Bool in the fold accumulator; restart only once (first batch with `norm_at > corrected_ts`), then label from the post-restart position. Extend the restart test with a third batch pinning co_nudge.

title: group-by-at logic now exists in three modules
detail: The identical prepend/reverse grouping fold exists in the server builder, the client panel, and the client test fixture. Cadence/batch semantics live in three copies; a change (e.g. correction restart) must be made three times and can drift silently.
recommended_fix: Extract the grouping into shared/reference_call.gleam next to the attempts codec and reuse from the server builder; drive client fixtures from explicit `attempt_log` literals instead of mirroring the builder.
